fullDescription: A botanical-inspired, soft minimalist design system characterized by organic curves, a warm cream and sage green palette, and editorial serif typography. This aesthetic is ideal for lifestyle, education, wellness, or plant-care applications, emphasizing a calm and organized user experience. Key visual markers include large border radii (up to 32px), delicate borders (#E1E9E2), and sophisticated font pairing between 'Gambetta' serif and 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. The layout features horizontal-scrolling card carousels, immersive hero sections with glassmorphism overlays, and a bottom-tab navigation system typical of modern mobile mini-apps.

structured.summary: A fresh, educational mobile UI design featuring a high-contrast 'Forest and Cream' theme, sophisticated serif headings, and large, rounded components that create an approachable, organic feel. The interface uses subtle color accents to differentiate categories (e.g., sage green for general info, soft coral for warnings or specific tips).

style.description: The style combines a warm off-white background (#FDFCF8) with deep forest greens (#1A2E22) and muted sage accents (#7BA880). Typography uses 'Gambetta' (serif) for headings to provide an editorial, authoritative look, and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for interface elements for readability. Components feature aggressive rounding (24px-32px), subtle borders (1px solid with 10-20% opacity), and light shadows. Micro-interactions include horizontal scrolling with hidden scrollbars and backdrop-blur glassmorphism effects on overlays.
style.prompt: Create a design with a background of #FDFCF8 and a primary text color of #334139. Use 'Gambetta' for all headings (20px to 30px, medium weight) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body and interface text (10px to 14px). Implement a core color palette of #1A2E22 (Primary Dark), #7BA880 (Sage Accent), and #E8F0E9 (Soft Wash). Use a border-radius of 32px for large containers and 24px for smaller cards. Incorporate glassmorphism using 'backdrop-filter: blur(12px)' and white/20% borders for tags. For images, apply a 'mix-blend-mode: multiply' over a light green background to create a cohesive tinted aesthetic. Spacing should follow a 16px/24px grid.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling mobile-first layout with a fixed header and footer. Content is organized into distinct semantic sections: Hero, Horizontal Carousel, and Featured Blocks.

prompts.prompt: Top-aligned header with 56px padding-top. Left-side vertical stack: a 12px uppercase tracking-widest label in #7BA880 and a 24px semibold heading in #1A2E22. Right-side: A 40x40px circular profile container in #E8F0E9 with a centered 20px icon in #7BA880 and a 20% opacity border.

Large 4:3 aspect ratio card with 32px border-radius. Features a full-width background image with an 'inset-0' linear gradient from transparent at the top to #1A2E22 at 60% opacity at the bottom. Bottom-left aligned content: a pill-shaped tag (white/20 background, 1px white/30 border) followed by a 30px medium-weight serif title in white and a 14px secondary text line in white/80%.

Horizontal scrolling container with 'overflow-x-auto' and hidden scrollbars. Cards are 260px wide with 24px padding and 24px border-radius. Each card includes a 40x40px icon box in the top-left with a 12px border-radius. Title should be 18px semibold. Body text should be 14px with 'leading-relaxed' (1.6 line height). Use #F4F7F4 for green-themed cards and #FEF6F6 for coral-themed cards.

A wide card container with #F9FAF9 background and #E8EEE9 border. 24px internal padding. Left side: 20px heading, 14px muted body text, and a primary button (solid #1A2E22, white text, 16px radius, 'Start Lesson' text + arrow icon). Right side: 96x96px image container with 16px border-radius.

Fixed 80px tall footer with white background and 1px top border (#F3F4F6). Contains 4 equally spaced navigation items. Each item is a flex-column with a 24px icon and a 10px label. Active state uses #1A2E22; inactive/hover states use gray-400 or #7BA880.

special_ui_components.description: Transparent floating tag used for categories over imagery.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a small badge with 'padding: 4px 12px', 'background: rgba(255,255,255, 0.2)', 'backdrop-filter: blur(8px)', and a 'border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255, 0.3)'. Text inside should be 10px-12px, uppercase, white, with 0.05em tracking.

special_ui_components.description: Information cards with unique color-coding based on content type.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create cards using #F4F7F4 (green type) or #FEF6F6 (coral type). Each must have a 1px border colored slightly darker than the background (e.g., #E1E9E2 for green). Icon containers inside must be pure white with a 12px radius and a subtle 1px border.
